boxplotA.png.description: A box plot skewed left, with no number line
boxplotA.png.quiz-description: A box plot with no number line. Its left whisker is long, about a third of the plot's width; its box covers about the next half, with the median line about three fifths of the way across the box; and its right whisker is short, about a tenth of the plot's width.

boxplotB.png.description: A box plot skewed right, with no number line
boxplotB.png.quiz-description: A box plot with no number line. Its left whisker is very short, about a twentieth of the plot's width; its box covers about the next half, with the median line in the middle of the box; and its right whisker is long, about half the plot's width.

boxplotC.png.description: A symmetric box plot, with no number line
boxplotC.png.quiz-description: A box plot with no number line. Its narrow box is in the middle, covering about a sixth of the plot's width, with the median line in the middle of the box; its two whiskers are equally long, each about two fifths of the plot's width.
